result.topic_en: The page gives the explicit root (Cardano-type formula) of the general cubic equation ax^3+3bx^2+3cx+d=0 and states that the product of the two cube roots always equals b^2-ac.
result.transcription:
Wurzel der cubischen Gleichung
$ax^3 + 3bxx + 3cx + d = 0$
ist
$ax = -b + \sqrt[3]{\left[-b^3 + \frac{3}{2}abc - \frac{1}{2}aad + a\sqrt{(4ac^3 + 4b^3d + aadd - 6abcd - 3bbcc)}\right]}$
$+ \sqrt[3]{\left[-b^3 + \frac{3}{2}abc - \frac{1}{2}aad - a\sqrt{(4ac^3 + 4b^3d + aadd - 6abcd - 3bbcc)}\right]}$
Das Product der beiden Cubicwurzeln ist allezeit
$= bb - ac$

methods.what: Explicit radical (Cardano-type) formula for a root of the general cubic with binomial-style coefficients
Product of the two cube roots in the formula equals b^2 - ac (constraint fixing which cube roots are paired)
methods.quote:

$= bb - ac$
